name: Wedding Dress
description: Guidelines for traveling with wedding dress in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Wedding dresses are allowed in carry-on baggage. Call your airline in advance to see if they have closet space to hang the dress in the cabin.

checkedBag.reason: Wedding dresses are allowed in checked baggage, though carry-on is highly recommended to protect against damage or lost bags.
